title: Support of a proper-support direct-image section
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative ring, f:X->Y be separated and locally of finite type and F an etale sheaf of Lambda-modules [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For V etale over Y and s in the proper-support subsheaf at V [lem-cbc-proper-support-section-calculus], there are closed subsets T of X_V and I of V such that T is precisely the nonzero-germ support of the underlying section, T is proper over V, I is its closed image, and I is precisely the nonzero-germ support of s as a section of the proper-support subsheaf. All germs are tested at separably closed geometric points.

source.place: Tag 0F50, composition of direct image with proper supports; closed-image support calculation

proof.text: Use the actual proper-support predicate to obtain the closed support T and properness; take its closed image I under the projection.
Off I restrict to the open complement. Every geometric germ of the underlying section is zero there. The zero-open theorem shows the restriction is zero, and hence its direct-image germ is zero.

If a direct-image germ at a point of I were zero, the zero-open theorem gives a zero neighbourhood. Choose an algebraically closed geometric point of T above it, lift it into that neighbourhood through the Cartesian restriction square, and use germ compatibility to contradict membership in T.

lean.statement:
theorem properSupportSectionImage (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (V : Y.Etale)
    (s : ((properSupportLowerStar Λ f).obj F).obj.obj (op V)) :
    ∃ (T : TopologicalSpace.Closeds (f.Etale.obj V).left)
      (I : TopologicalSpace.Closeds V.left),
      (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
        (v : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ (f.Etale.obj V).left), v default ∈ T ↔
        (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (v ≫ (f.Etale.obj V).hom)).toPresheafFiber
          (f.Etale.obj V) (Over.homMk v) F.obj s.val ≠ 0) ∧
      Scheme.IsClosedSubsetProperOver (pullback.fst V.hom f) T ∧
      (I : Set V.left) =
        (fun x : (f.Etale.obj V).left => pullback.fst V.hom f x) '' (T : Set _) ∧
      (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (v : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ V.left),
        v default ∈ I ↔ (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (v ≫ V.hom)).toPresheafFiber V
          (Over.homMk v) ((properSupportLowerStar Λ f).obj F).obj s ≠ 0)
